translations.web: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
translations.bsb: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
translations.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
translations.asv: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts and mountains and caves, and the holes of the earth.
